title: Centralized XODR local-frame rebase with unified absolute-coordinate coverage

defect_summary.divergent_implementations: Two independent rebase implementations existed with DISJOINT absolute-coordinate coverage. regen_map_of_record._rebase_to_local shifted only planView/geometry x/y and object/outline/cornerGlobal x/y. runtime_tile_builder._rebase_geometry shifted geometry x/y, cornerGlobal x/y and positionInertial x/y. A map containing <object>/<signal> with absolute x/y kept those values in the global tmerc frame while roads were localized.
defect_summary.uncovered_absolute_elements: Object and signal elements in the OpenDRIVE header-frame carry absolute x/y; neither old implementation translated them, so any such element ended up ~832km/5458km away from its road while everything else was local -- the same frame-disagreement class that produced the earlier verified 7,665m building/road centroid drift.
defect_summary.lenient_origin: regen parsed geometry with float(g.get('x','0')) implicitly defaulting missing attributes to 0 and had no non-finite guard, so x='nan' corrupted dx/dy and silently wrote a destroyed map.

corrected_semantics.single_engine: ultimate_pipeline/geometry/opendrive_rebase.py is now the only rebase core. Both call sites share exact (dx, dy) identity: regen (origin = planView bbox min, offset preserved as (dx,dy)) and runtime tile builder (origin = request.center_x/center_y, offset zeroed).
corrected_semantics.unified_coverage: STRICT (missing/non-numeric/non-finite aborts with UnboundedCoordinateError): planView/geometry x/y, cornerGlobal x/y, positionInertial x/y. OPTIONAL (translated only when the attribute exists, so s/t road-relative metadata stays untouched): object x/y, signal x/y. cornerLocal/positionRoad/positionLane/polynomial params are never translated.
corrected_semantics.fail_closed_degenerate_input: non-finite or missing geometry x/y raises before any output is written instead of corrupting the shift vector.
corrected_semantics.provenance: _rebase_to_local report now includes translated_elements (per-kind element counts) alongside dx/dy/bbox/hashes.
corrected_semantics.regression_impact: Real pinned candidates carry object/signal WITHOUT x/y (s/t-positioned metadata), so canonical outputs are unchanged; the engine's optional selectors are no-ops on the real map population (empirically verified).

coverage.A: planview_min_xy derives the local origin from geometry mins
coverage.B: geometry + cornerGlobal translated by the SAME (dx,dy) with exact 6dp values; coverage keys set
coverage.C: positionInertial translated; object/signal x/y translated when present; s/t-only object/signal untouched byte-for-byte
coverage.G: regen._rebase_to_local adopts full coverage union; report translated_elements; header offset preserved as (dx,dy)
coverage.H: regen already-local noop preserved (no file written)
coverage.I: regen aborts on degenerate geometry before writing output
coverage.J: runtime tile builder translates the same absolute-coordinate set; header offset zeroed; sidecar manifest binds
coverage.K: real pinned candidate empirical: population is exactly planview_geometry + corner_global, objects/signals carry no x/y, candidate is already local

regression_results.focused: 42 passed (engine + existing regen/buildings/sumo/tile suites all green)

residual_risks: The engine assumes a uniform header frame; a map with a nonzero header <offset> z or hdg transform is rejected only by the runtime tile builder (_read_source_header_offset). regen's canonical path does not yet refuse nonzero offset z/hdg -- downstream XODR read gates enforce that separately.

object/signal optional x/y translation is best-effort: an element carrying x but not y gets only x shifted, which would leave an inconsistent frame; real maps never produce that shape (verified on the pinned candidate).

Runtime tile geometry text serialization changed from repr(float) to fixed 6dp. Numeric values are unchanged; only textual form of the geometry attributes differs (affects tile output hashes vs. historical runtime tiles).
